# P37.11 — SAM.gov sweep resumes where it stopped (D-FEDERAL.1-1)

Manifest row 432 · `docs/tickets/432_P37.11__sam-gov-sweep-resume.md` · Round 11 / P37 (11D) · R11-SRC-02
Harness: devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent · Base: `r11/P37.10-asset-promotion-gate`

## What

The `D-FEDERAL.1-1` engineering half — the hosted sweep's starvation fix:

- **Measured-quota budget** — `[sam_gov_sweep].daily_request_budget` `30 → 10`
  (the measured daily api.data.gov quota: documented 10/day free tier; hosted
  run rows served 11 and 12 before the 429 wall), so a fresh-window run stops
  at headroom instead of burning to the wall.
- **Persisted rotating cursor** — `fetch_record.sweep_cursor` /
  `sweep_cursor_next` ride every `sam_gov` run row; the scheduled wrapper
  seeds each run from the newest stored row (`latest_sweep_cursor`), so a
  budget below the 19-keyword count pages coverage across weekly fires
  instead of restarting at keyword 0 — the recorded starvation.
- **Resume past the last issued slice** — `sam_gov_sweep_resume` leaves the
  cursor at `(start + issued_selected) mod n`: skipped governed slices map
  back to selected keywords, so a mid-page stop defers to the next window,
  never re-probes within one.
- **ADR-236** records the decision (amends ADR-089's budget≥count bound; its
  revisit trigger answered: the measured quota, not the keyword count, broke
  the premise).
